checks.name: item 1: GET /invite renders the entry; POST /invite/validate validates the code by digest (normalized input) and, without consuming a redemption slot (redeemed_count 0, no pending admission), creates the 10-minute single-use signup handoff (flow kind signup bound to a presignup reservation and the provider invitation id) and performs the backend PAR with the capability's invite_token; the browser receives only a 303 to /t/{slug}/auth/authorize with client_id and request_uri and the __Host- pre-login cookie

item 2: the hosted registration consumes the bound invitation and the callback lands on /auth/pending with a 24-hour pending admission; the registered account and its pre-access session mint no principal, redemption or workspace session (uniform 404); only the later verified sign-in redeems (code exhausted at 1 of 1)

item 1 (honest states): unknown, malformed, expired, revoked, exhausted codes and a code without a provider invitation receive the same neutral 400 page, headers and body included ("could not be used"), consume nothing and make no provider call; the code is never shown back

item 4/5: invitation floods hit 5/minute per address class with the honest limited page (429, Retry-After) before any code is judged, valid codes included; rotating forged X-Forwarded-For from an untrusted peer never evades the peer's budget; behind the trusted load balancer the rightmost hop is the client; one code holds at most 10 live presignup reservations (the eleventh is neutral with no PAR) and none consumes a redemption slot; dispatch counters show no provider call for any denied request

item 2: missing, wrong-email and other-tenant provider invitations cannot create an account through the hosted registration (refused, invitation untouched), a sign-in request offers no generic signup, and a provider-revoked or already-consumed invitation is refused at the backend PAR (neutral page, flow discarded); a leaked or replayed used code obtains nothing

item 3: a wrong state consumes the signup flow and a replay of the right one then finds nothing (no token request); a Canary code and state injected into a Northstar flow's browser are refused (no pre-access); a signup handoff past its 10 minutes admits nothing

item 3: client-provided organization, tenant, role(s), redirect, destination and invite_token fields refuse with the neutral page; cross-site, foreign-Origin and metadata-less posts are 403 cross_site; none reserves, starts a flow or calls the provider; under Northstar's scope a Canary code reserves nothing and its capability is not found

item 2/3: an operator-preprovisioned Canary code hands off to the Canary tenant only and its member joins only Canary; the Northstar member only Northstar; each workspace opens for its own member; a Canary identity at Northstar's sign-in is denied with nothing minted

item 2/5: 70 probes of the workspace, query, import, generation, export and record route families by anonymous, malformed, pre-access (also presented as a session), expired, entitlement-revoked and foreign-scoped principals all answer the byte-identical uniform 404 (problem+json, no-store, nosniff, no Set-Cookie) with no provider dispatch; admitted Northstar and Canary members still get the uniform 404 for the unimplemented import, generation and export families, which are not counted as features; a registered pre-access identity holds no principal

provider faults at the backend PAR (503, and an answer past the 3-second client deadline) give the neutral page inside the 5-second handler deadline, discard the flow and consume no slot; the presignup reservation simply lapses in 10 minutes (the create/revoke timeout and reconciliation exercise is APP-082's)

item 1: 163 responses carry no raw code, invite_token, issued code, token or request_uri outside the authorize redirect; the database (135814 bytes dumped) holds no raw code or invitation token; 64 captured log lines carry none of them and no cookie value, while recording invite.validate outcomes

limits: The provider is the cfg(test) synthetic loopback issuer (PAR, hosted registration, token) plus the loopback management stand-in app/runtime/fake_fauth.py; the test copies each invitation token from the operator's capability file into the issuer (one simulated provider). Never the deployed fAuth; hosted PAR, real mail and browsers are APP-076/079.
Synthetic local password authentication over TLS, not RDS IAM; synthetic identifiers.
The route-level admission race repeat and the provider create/revoke fault exercise are APP-082's (ADR-010).
Raw codes and invitation tokens are never written to this report.
scope: APP-074 local public invitation entry on the native PostgreSQL TLS fixture with the cfg(test) synthetic loopback issuer and the loopback fAuth management stand-in
